subject.title: fix: prevent memory flush failure from aborting user reply (#85645)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this fail-open memoryFlush recovery behavior: ignore visible flush error payloads for the user reply, rotate exhausted sessions without deleting old transcripts, and reuse `compaction.notifyUser` for a degraded notice?
rationale: The patch looks technically sound, but the final behavior changes session-state recovery and user-visible notice semantics in a compatibility-sensitive reply pipeline.

options.title: Accept fail-open recovery
options.body: Merge after confirming that liveness should win over preserving the bloated active session in the exhausted memoryFlush case.

options.title: Narrow the notice behavior
options.body: Keep log-and-continue plus rotation, but remove or split the `notifyUser` degraded notice if existing `notifyUser=true` deployments should not receive new message types.

options.title: Pause for broader compaction direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose a combined direction with the adjacent memoryFlush/preflight-compaction ordering work.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-open recovery
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that liveness should win over preserving the bloated active session in the exhausted memoryFlush case.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the project decision owner and has the clearest history on memoryFlush recovery plus the merged partial mitigation.
